messages:
sasha: quick Q — were adding a small response field for /v1/complete: `served_model.variant`. planning to return an object for `served_model` when available. does that break existing clients that expect a string?

sasha: example response were proposing:
```json
{
  "id": "req_123",
  "model": "redwood/fast-7b",
  "served_model": {
    "id": "redwood/fast-7b-q4",
    "variant": "quantized-v2",
    "region": "us-west-2"
  },
  "choices": [ /* ... */ ]
}
```

ben: optional new fields should be fine if were careful, but note some internal consumers parse `served_model` as a string right now. if we only add an optional object we need server-side compatibility to keep returning strings for legacy consumers or accept both.

maya: also, were introducing a request-side routing hint param: `route_hint` (examples: `region=us-west-2,tier=dedicated` or `pin=redwood/fast-7b-q4`). need doc + SDK examples. pinging @kevin for SDK impact.

kevin: SDK side: if `served_model` stays optional and responses can be string OR object we should update deserializers to accept either without a major semver bump. if the shape of `served_model.id` changes (e.g. removing model name), thats a breaking change.

triage-bot: Contract-lint job failed on master for /v1/complete: rule `served_model_type` — response must be object OR string. failing test case: server returned string in new object-only code path.

sasha: ah — legacy behaviour did allow `served_model` as a naked string ("redwood/fast-7b"). plan: support both for now, prefer object. PR will add compatibility layer + tests. ok?

ben: ok, but add a clear migration note in the changelog and docs. also mention fallback semantics when `route_hint` specifies a variant that the pinned model doesnt support — we should define whether to error or pick the closest compatible variant.

maya: proposal: runtime should fallback gracefully: if `pin` is set and requested variant incompatible, log a warning + emit metric `routing.incompatible_variant` and pick next variant from `fallback_order`. can we add that?

sasha: yes, will add metric + fallback logic. opening PR and tests now. code review ping @kevin @ben. canary plan: 5% for 24h. @deploy-bot can you schedule?

deploy-bot: scheduled canary -> service=router, rollout=5%, duration=24h, start=2026-03-18T15:00:00Z. will post progress.

kevin: Ill review SDK changes today. note: add unit tests for deserializers that accept both string and object forms, and ensure typed clients surface `served_model` as a typed union.

ben: :thumbsup: docs nit — show an example `route_hint=region=eu-central-1,tier=hosted` (we use comma delim). sasha please include sample in docs.

sasha: updated PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5123 — includes tests, compatibility shim, metric + changelog. thanks all!
